_note: STAKK photoreal cut: edit decision list. Read by src/tools/conform.py (bakes graded, retimed 30 fps JPEG sequences into src/footage/<seq>/) and by the page (src/footage/manifest.json). Times: edit seconds (cues.json grid). keys: [t_edit, t_source, speed_in, speed_out]; between keys the source time follows a cubic Hermite with those speeds (so speed ramps are smooth and measured). Source clips are 24 fps, 1080x1912.
